states.changed: A visitor meets thirty-five passages of law on AI compute sorted by the mood of the sentence and by where it stands, sieves them for a command in force, and finds none addressed to whoever holds the chips.

A visitor can now sieve the passages by how a sentence picks out the one who must act (a handing over, a deed done, a holding, an office), finds no command in force hung on a holding, and reads eight fining clauses from 1962 to 2024 in which "may impose" and "shall be subject" follow who fines, not who is fined.
